first.say: Hey! You're the new owner, right? You're the new owner. I'm Dylan. I'm basically here anyway, so, do you need anybody?

options.text: Ask me again in a week or two.

first_can.say: Dressing rooms, washrooms, skate rental, the snowbank. Can I drive the girl? Doris, I mean. No. Not yet. But I'm ready.

first_school.say: It's 3:40, boss. School ended at 3:30. I ran. Is running allowed in the lobby? It is now.

first_later.say: A week or two. Cool. Cool cool. I'll be here. I'm always here. I'm here right now.

say: Boss, people are kind of mad at the rental window. About the skates. And the line. And me, a bit.

grumpy2.say: Line was out the door and half the size nines are rusted. A kid cried. Okay, I also cried a little, in washroom 2, which is its own problem.

maddie.say: Watch the chair. Watch it. She's letting go. She's not letting go. She's going to, though. Right? Right.

maddie2.say: Yeah. She falls like me, so she's got that going for her.

closing2.say: See, this is why this is the best job in the valley. Pizza and a Zambelli. Well. Pizza.

say: Boss! Guess what. No, guess. Okay, I'll tell you. Nothing. But it was fun.

job.say: Skate rental is a lot of feet, boss. So many feet. Washroom 2 is a nightmare. I've made peace with it. I haven't.

events.say: Stick and puck, obviously. The Dukes practicing. And the Halloween skate, because I run the haunted dressing room, which is me in a goalie mask.

events2.say: Is it scary? It's a little scary. Birdie Whitehorse cried, so I gave her the mask. Now she's the haunted dressing room.

earl.say: Earl calls me 'the new kid'. I've been here four years. Is that a compliment? It's not. It might be.

josie.say: Josie? What about Josie? Nothing about Josie. She laughs at my jokes, which, statistically, is something.

options.text: Ask her to the Christmas skate.

josie_ask.say: The Christmas skate. With the lights. Okay. Okay. If this goes badly I'm moving to Harlow Falls.

twenty.say: He said that? He SAID that? Twenty. I've done four. Boss. Boss. I'm going to do sixteen more.

rink_good.say: Way better. Tommy said it's 'basically Duncannon'. It's not. But he said it.

rink_rooms.say: Washroom 2 has a door that locks now. I want to put up a plaque.

cup.say: Okay. The Double-Double cup in the snowbank. That's mine. Grade 9. I wanted to see how long it would last. It's been three winters. It's kind of a landmark now.

cup_keep.say: Really? Boss. That's the nicest thing anybody's ever said about my garbage.

cup_gone.say: Yeah. Yeah, okay. End of an era. I'll say a few words.

do.note: Dylan Pruitt removed the Double-Double cup from the parking lot snowbank. He said a few words.

coach_maddie.say: She says you said 'good'. Once. She's been saying it to the cat.
